removeDialog.title: Delete this task record?
removeDialog.withFiles: {{title}} — the downloaded files will be moved to the trash too.

removeBatchDialog.title: Delete the records of this batch?
removeBatchDialog.withFiles: All tasks of {{title}} — their downloaded files will be moved to the trash too.
removeBatchDialog.keepFiles: All tasks of {{title}} — files on disk are kept.

resuming.title: Download interrupted, resuming shortly
resuming.hint: It continues from where it stopped after the time above, or you can retry now.

noSpace.title: Not enough disk space
noSpace.hint: Free up space or choose another download folder in Settings, then retry.

permission.title: No write permission
permission.hint: Choose another download folder in Settings or check this folder's permissions, then retry.

expired.title: Media link expired or refused
expired.hint: Retrying parses the post again to get a fresh link. If it keeps happening, sign in again in the in-app browser.

network.title: Network error
network.hint: Check your network or system proxy, then retry. On a slow network, increase the connection timeout in Settings.

convert.title: Merge or conversion failed
convert.hint: Check that FFmpeg is available under Settings → Tools & updates, then retry.

generic.title: Download failed
generic.hint: You can retry right away. If it keeps failing, export the diagnostics log to look into it.

files.empty: Files show up here once saved. Pausing and cancelling keep the partly downloaded files.
files.missing: File not found; it may have been moved or deleted

logNote: Shows the latest 150 entries. Sensitive request details are hidden.

limit.label: Task speed limit (KiB/s)
limit.description: 0 means no limit. Pause a running download first, then resume it after the change.
